name: Leviticus
lede: The third book of the Bible, in full: every law and every scene in the words of the ASV.

books.name: The Offerings
books.blurb: Jehovah calls to Moses out of the tent of meeting: the burnt-offering of the herd, the flock and the birds, the meal-offering seasoned with salt, the peace-offerings, the sin-offering for the priest, the congregation, the ruler and the common people, and the trespass-offering with its fifth part.

books.name: The Consecration
books.blurb: The law of each offering — the fire on the altar that shall never go out, the portions of the priests, the sacrifice of thanksgiving, no fat and no blood, the wave-breast and the heave-thigh — and the seven days in which Moses washed, clothed and anointed Aaron and his sons.

books.name: Strange Fire
books.blurb: The eighth day, Aaron's first offerings and the fire that came forth from before Jehovah; the strange fire of Nadab and Abihu, and Aaron holding his peace; no wine in the tent of meeting; and the beasts, the fish, the birds and the creeping things, clean and unclean.

books.name: The Plague of Leprosy
books.blurb: The days of purifying after a birth, and the priest looking on the plague: the rising, the scab and the bright spot, the hair turned white, the raw flesh, the boil, the burning, the scall, the leper crying Unclean, unclean, without the camp, and the plague in a garment.

books.name: The Cleansing
books.blurb: The law of the leper in the day of his cleansing: two living birds, cedar, scarlet and hyssop, the bird let go into the open field, the eighth day and the log of oil; the plague in the walls of a house; and the laws of issues, that they die not in their uncleanness.

books.name: The Day of Atonement
books.blurb: Aaron in the holy linen garments, the two goats and the lots, the cloud of incense over the mercy-seat, the live goat bearing all their iniquities into a solitary land, the tenth day of the seventh month; the life of the flesh is in the blood; and the doings of Egypt and of Canaan ye shall not do.
